items.title: Surprise Events and Tail Probabilities
items.summary_short: 540 Polymarket markets traded past 95% confidence and then resolved the other way. What kinds of markets they were, and which of those a different contract shape would reach.

items.title: Are Polymarket Traders Hedging on Trade.xyz?
items.summary_short: Matching 338 million Trade.xyz fills against 63,264 Polymarket finance bettors to find traders holding offsetting positions on both venues. The simplest version of that trade is not happening.
